items.title: AI relief rally fades after opening bell as Nvidia turns negative
items.summary: US equities advanced in early Black Friday trading, but technology gains were smaller than premarket futures had suggested. Nvidia reversed its premarket rise while storage, networking and power infrastructure shares remained higher in early reports. The divergence underscores unresolved financing and valuation concerns.

observations.label: AP regular session snapshot 9:51 AM ET
observations.value: S&P 500 +0.7%, Nasdaq Composite +0.9%, Dow +0.6%, Nvidia -1.7%; 10-year Treasury yield 4.89%.

observations.label: Yahoo Finance early premarket
observations.value: Nvidia nearly +4%, Nasdaq-100 futures +2.8%; futures and cash index are different instruments.

observations.label: Independent early-session reporting
observations.value: Business Insider reported Nvidia -2.5% at its snapshot; Barron's reported Sandisk +5.2%, Marvell +1.7%, Bloom Energy +0.9%. Intraday figures, not closes.

observations.label: Next indicators
observations.value: Semiconductor breadth, trading volume, credit spreads and Nvidia's price into the 1 PM ET close; renewed broad strength would weaken the opening-fade signal.

items.key_finding: The opening session shows a selective technology rebound rather than the broad surge suggested by premarket trading.

items.title: Brent contract roll explains divergent benchmark quotes ahead of OPEC+ meeting
items.summary: Market reports show materially different Brent prices because some feeds quote January delivery and others February delivery. The nearer contract expires Monday and commands a substantial premium. The difference should not be interpreted as an abrupt reduction in geopolitical supply risk.

observations.label: FinanceFeeds citing ICE/CNBC, 8:00 AM ET
observations.value: January Brent $96.30; February Brent reported at $91.90 in the same morning report, approximately $4.40 lower. Intraday quotes, not settlements.

observations.label: ICE contract expiration rule
observations.value: Trading ceases on the last business day of the second month before delivery; January 2027 Brent expires November 30, 2026.

observations.label: Independent oil-market context
observations.value: WSJ reported a $4.28 near-month premium and mixed crude prices ahead of the November 29 OPEC+ meeting.

observations.label: Next indicators
observations.value: February-March spread after the roll, official OPEC+ decision, actual cargo flows and refinery restarts. Narrowing spreads and recovering flows would weaken the scarcity signal.

items.key_finding: Compare like-for-like Brent delivery months to distinguish genuine price changes from mechanical benchmark rolls.

items.title: Brazilian financial ADRs surge following finance minister appointment
items.summary: Bradesco chairman Luiz Carlos Trabuco accepted the finance minister role for 2027. Brazilian financial shares rallied in US premarket trading as investors anticipated improved fiscal credibility. Actual fiscal reforms and sustainable debt stabilization remain unproven.

observations.label: Premarket November 27, StockTitan
observations.value: XP +19.74% at 6:35 AM ET; BBD +18.11% at 6:37 AM ET.

observations.label: Separate premarket snapshot
observations.value: STNE +16.58%, PAGS +12.99%, XP +15.36%; snapshot time not specified.

observations.label: Policy context
observations.value: Reuters reports policy rate 13.75%, government debt near 83% of GDP.

observations.label: Next indicators
observations.value: Fiscal reform, currency strength, rates and legislative support; absent fiscal follow-through would undermine the rally.

items.key_finding: Policy optimism is driving broad Brazilian financial-sector repricing, not yet demonstrated earnings improvement.

items.title: Alvotech falls after US biosimilar injunction
items.summary: A US court granted a preliminary injunction relating to Alvotech's proposed golimumab biosimilar. Alvotech plans an appeal and says demand for existing approved products remains strong. The order creates launch-timing and legal uncertainty rather than establishing a company-wide demand deterioration.

observations.label: Premarket move
observations.value: StockTitan reports ALVO -8.79% at 6:18 AM ET on November 27; Unusual Whales reports approximately -10% in its 7:45 AM update.

observations.label: Company disclosure
observations.value: November 26 announcement; November 27 6-K; injunction concerns a manufacturing-process patent; company intends expedited appeal.

observations.label: Next indicators
observations.value: Appeal docket, launch timing, cash flow and existing product demand; prolonged injunction could impair growth.

items.key_finding: A specific legal setback creates a material product-launch risk while existing demand remains strong according to management.

items.title: Venezuela refinery fire adds regional fuel-supply uncertainty
items.summary: PDVSA confirmed a fire at the Amuay refinery on Thursday and said domestic fuel distribution was unaffected. Reuters sources reported a temporary processing interruption, which PDVSA did not confirm. Actual output losses and restart timing remain unknown.

observations.label: Refinery capacity and reported throughput
observations.value: 645,000 barrels/day nameplate; approximately 67,000 barrels/day actual processing before incident, per Reuters.

observations.label: Operational status
observations.value: Fire extinguished; temporary interruption reported by a worker; PDVSA did not confirm processing status.

observations.label: Next indicators
observations.value: Restart and actual throughput, product exports and refining margins; rapid restart would limit impact.

items.key_finding: Confirmed refinery fire adds supply-chain risk, but lost output is unquantified and crude-export loss is not established.
